test_cases.title: Open mobile menu
steps: Click the 'Open mobile menu' button.
test_cases.expected: The mobile navigation menu is displayed.

test_cases.title: Close mobile menu by clicking the button again
steps: Click the 'Open mobile menu' button to open it.
Click the 'Open mobile menu' button again.
test_cases.expected: The mobile navigation menu is hidden.

test_cases.title: Open user profile
steps: Click the 'tushar (User Profile)' button.
test_cases.expected: The user profile or account options menu is displayed.

test_cases.title: Click user profile button when already open
steps: Click the 'tushar (User Profile)' button to open it.
Click the 'tushar (User Profile)' button again.
test_cases.expected: The user profile or account options menu is hidden or remains open with no change.

test_cases.title: Navigate to previous trip in carousel
steps: Ensure the carousel is not on the first trip slide.
Click the 'Previous trip' button.
test_cases.expected: The carousel navigates to the preceding trip slide.

test_cases.title: Attempt to navigate previous from the first trip
steps: Navigate to the first trip slide in the 'Upcoming memories' carousel.
Click the 'Previous trip' button.
test_cases.expected: The carousel remains on the first trip slide, or loops to the last trip slide.

test_cases.title: Navigate to next trip in carousel
steps: Ensure the carousel is not on the last trip slide.
Click the 'Next trip' button.
test_cases.expected: The carousel navigates to the subsequent trip slide.

test_cases.title: Attempt to navigate next from the last trip
steps: Navigate to the last trip slide in the 'Upcoming memories' carousel.
Click the 'Next trip' button.
test_cases.expected: The carousel remains on the last trip slide, or loops to the first trip slide.
